# @neural-ng/mcp-server

Read-only NeuralNg MCP server for component contracts and compact theme recipes.

RUN
npx -y @neural-ng/mcp-server

COMPONENT TOOLS
- search_components: search selectors, entry points, README and llms.txt text.
- get_component_contract: resolve exact public selector/model/form contracts.
- recommend_components: deterministic component recommendations for a UI goal.

THEME TOOLS
- create_theme_recipe: create a sparse recipe from high-level decisions.
- validate_theme_recipe: validate compact JSON against schema and token contract.
- edit_theme_recipe: apply safe dotted set/unset changes and revalidate.
- diff_theme_recipes: return only changed compact recipe paths.
- get_component_theme_contract: read one component's supported theme properties.
- compile_theme_recipe: return summary, diagnostics and artifact sizes, not full CSS.

RESOURCES
- neural://catalog
- neural://package/exports
- neural://themes/catalog
- neural://themes/schema
- neural://themes/presets
- neural://themes/presets/neutral
- neural://themes/presets/glass
- neural://themes/presets/mist
- neural://themes/presets/futuristic
- neural://themes/ai-guide
- neural://components/{id}/contract
- neural://components/{id}/readme
- neural://components/{id}/llms

THEME RULES
- Choose neutral, glass, mist, or futuristic as the compact recipe base.
- Work on the compact recipe; do not emit or request all 1,348 resolved tokens.
- Read only the target component theme contract before adding component overrides.
- Prefer detail=names. Request defaults only when values are required.
- Validate every created or edited recipe.
- Use diff_theme_recipes instead of repeating unchanged recipe fields.
- Use `npx neural-theme build` to write CSS, tokens, reports and type artifacts.

GENERAL RULES
- Treat MCP results as read-only package documentation and deterministic tooling.
- Import components from the exact entryPoint returned by the contract.
- Use returned selectors and model names; do not invent aliases.
- The server does not edit projects, execute shell commands, install packages,
  access the network or read arbitrary filesystem paths.

THEME QUALITY AND MIGRATION
- Prefer presets with quality=release unless the user explicitly requests preview styling.
- Neutral is release quality; Glass, Mist, and Futuristic are experimental preview presets.
- Theme validation rejects declaration injection, external CSS URLs and malformed aliases.
- MCP does not rewrite legacy recipes. Use neural-theme migrate or migrateThemeRecipe() first.
